regime_context: The TSX thematic momentum leader is Big Banks, which is eligible via the absolute trend gate, has broad breadth (1.0), and durability (0.74), but is crowded (crowding_z 1.33). The gate has historically helped reduce drawdowns. No one-narrative dominates, and rotation signals are not directional. Momentum ranks are a focus lens only; the sole validated edge is drawdown control via trend eligibility.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The absolute trend gate has historically controlled drawdowns, and Big Banks remains eligible with high breadth and solid durability. Despite crowding suggesting a cap on upside, the trend discipline supports a moderate overweight. The mixed Hurst warns against a strong trend forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding and mixed trend (hurst=mixed) suggest a mature theme prone to consolidation or sharp reversals; the gate may provide only partial protection during a mean-reversion episode.

falsifier.text: Big Banks becomes ineligible (absolute trend gate) or durability_bar drops below 0.6, indicating the trend has lost staying power.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals is ineligible under the absolute trend gate, with very low durability and zero breadth, indicating no detectable trend. The validated edge is avoiding such themes to reduce drawdowns.
theses.dissent: Sharp commodity price spikes or a macro catalyst could quickly re-establish a trend, causing the gate to declare eligibility later but after a missed move.

falsifier.text: Base Metals becomes eligible (durability_bar > 0.5 and breadth > 0.5) and the trend gate turns positive.
